fields.label: Action
fields.help: The action that the external access rule performs.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: User-provided description for the external access rule.

fields.label: Destination Ports
fields.help: A list of destination ports to which the external access rule applies.

fields.label: IP Protocol
fields.help: The IP protocol to which the external access rule applies.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The ID of the external access rule.

fields.label: Parent
fields.help: The resource name of the network policy.

fields.label: Priority
fields.help: External access rule priority, which determines the external access rule to use when multiple rules apply.

fields.label: Source Ports
fields.help: A list of source ports to which the external access rule applies.

fields.label: Destination IP Ranges
IP Address Range
fields.help: An IP address range in the CIDR format.
If destination ranges are specified, the external access rule applies only to traffic that has a destination IP address in these ranges.

fields.label: Source IP Ranges
IP Address Range
fields.help: An IP address range in the CIDR format.
If source ranges are specified, the external access rule applies only to traffic that has a source IP address in these ranges.
